nodes.name: In situ solvothermal CoFe-TDPAT NSA synthesis
nodes.procedure: 29.1 mg Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O and 12.4 mg H₆TDPAT were added in 10 mL of a mixed solvent consisting of DMF and methanol (volume ratio 1:2), and under magnetic stirring for 60 min. The resulting suspension was transferred into a 20 mL autoclave. A piece of clean IF was then introduced into this suspension. Subsequently, the autoclave was sealed and maintained for 24 h at 160°C and naturally cooled to room temperature. Finally, the product was thoroughly rinsed with DMF and methanol and dried at 60°C for 30 min in a vacuum drying oven.

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR peaks red-shifted to 1656.9, 1388.4, and 1515.4 cm⁻¹ indicating coordination of Co and Fe ions to carboxyl oxygen atoms of H₆TDPAT.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1A displays the FTIR spectra of H₆TDPAT and IF@CoFeTDPAT NSA. ... for IF@CoFe-TDPAT NSA, these peaks have red-shifted to 1656.9, 1388.4, and 1515.4 cm⁻¹, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution Co 2p XPS shows peaks at 780.9 and 796.5 eV (Co²⁺) with satellites at 785.7 and 802.8 eV; Fe 2p XPS shows peaks at 710.9 and 724.5 eV (Fe³⁺) with satellites at 715.6 and 733.2 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The deconvoluted Co 2p XPS spectrum (Figure 1B) shows peaks with binding energy values of 780.9 and 796.5 eV, which correspond to Co 2p₃/₂ and Co 2p₁/₂ of Co²⁺, respectively. The peaks at 785.7 and 802.8 eV are the satellite peaks. The Fe 2p XPS spectrum (Figure 1C) shows peaks located at 710.9 and 724.5 eV, which are ascribed to Fe 2p₃/₂ and Fe 2p₁/₂ of Fe³⁺, and at 715.6 and 733.2 eV, which are the satellite peaks.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows peaks at 9.6°, 11.8°, and 35.5° indicating formation of CoFe-TDPAT MOF structure on IF, plus IF peaks at 44.9°, 65.5°, and 82.4°.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1D shows the X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of IF@CoFe-TDPAT NSA... additional peaks at 9.6°, 11.8°, and 35.5° can be observed.

nodes.characterization_summary: FESEM reveals large-area high-density vertically aligned ultrathin interconnected nanosheet array with individual nanosheet thickness ≈14 nm and array thickness ≈411 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2A-C shows the Field emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM) images of IF@CoFe-TDPAT NSA at different magnifications... The thickness of each nanosheet is ≈14 nm (Figure 2C). The cross-section FESEM image (Figure 2D) reveals that the thickness of the nanosheet array is ≈411 nm.

properties.description: Porous nanofibrous structure with interconnected fibers, high surface area morphology

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows crumpled ultrathin nanosheets; HRTEM exhibits lattice spacing of 0.24 nm confirming crystallinity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM result (Figure 3A) shows the nanosheets are crumpled... Its HRTEM image (Figure 3B) exhibits lattices with spacing of 0.24 nm, further indicating that these nanosheets are crystalline.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX mapping shows uniform distribution of Fe, Co, N, C, O elements with Fe:Co ratio ≈2:1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) mapping images displayed in Figure 3D-H show the distribution of Fe, Co, N, C, and O... The EDX analysis reveals that the ratio of Fe to Co is ≈2:1.

nodes.characterization_summary: Double layer capacitance Cdl yields ECSA of 690 cm² for IF@CoFe-TDPAT NSA (vs 325 cm² for IF, 635 cm² for NPF).
nodes.evidence_snippet: ECSA of IF is 325 cm². After growth of CoFe-TDPAT NPF on IF, ECSA increases significantly to 635 cm². After growth of CoFe-TDPAT NSA, ECSA slightly increases to 690 cm².

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows charge transfer resistance Rct of 43.21 Ω for OER and 23.8 Ω for HER for IF@CoFe-TDPAT NSA.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The charge transfer resistances of IF are 1942 Ω for OER and 149.6 Ω for HER. ... After in situ self-assembly of CoFe-TDPAT NSA, this value further significantly decreases to 43.21 Ω for OER and 23.8 Ω for HER, respectively.
